findings.passage: I believe that they are straightforwardly unconstitutional. The right to vote is the most fundamental right that we have as Americans. And the courts have said time and time again that you cannot have a poll tax.
findings.note: Quoted by WEMU (as a state representative) on the 2016 House voter ID bills; the sentences are reproduced from the page's separate quote lines. He describes the bills as unconstitutional and compares the cost of ID to a poll tax.
